snippet.title: Thomas & Friends™: Wonders of Sodor | Announcement Livestream
snippet.description:
Discover more about Thomas & Friends™: Wonders of Sodor with Community and Marketing Director JD and Jamie, our resident Thomas & Friends fan! 

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- 

Join Thomas and his friends on a special journey across Sodor! Ride with the classic engines and enjoy timeless stories and new narratives from the drivers’ seats. Explore the Wonders of Sodor – fun and magic await! 

Thomas & Friends™: Wonders of Sodor tells classic and original tales inspired by different eras of the brand. Each story features full narration by the legendary Mark Moraghan for the ultimate storytelling immersion. 

Experience the sights, sounds, and feelings of Sodor as you explore iconic Thomas & Friends locations as you’ve never seen before. 

Thomas & Friends™: Wonders of  Sodor is out  now on Steam, Epic Games, PlayStation and Xbox via https://bit.ly/Wonders-Of-Sodor-Launch-4

Nintendo Switch is coming soon. 

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- 

Visit the Website 👉 https://www.wondersofsodor.com

View our FAQs 👉 https://support.dovetailgames.com/hc/en-us/articles/33097248634514

Wishlist on Steam 👉 https://store.steampowered.com/app/3743790/Thomas__Friends_Wonders_of_Sodor?utm_source=youtube&utm_campaign=wondersofsodorannounce&utm_medium=announcelivestream
